newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka slightly weaker on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka slightly weaker on dollar demand.

text.p: The taka ended slightly weaker at 42.5490/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading, dealers said.

Dealers said the taka eased only marginally after opening flat at 42.5480/5500 as it almost hit the central bank band of 42.53/55 despite demand spurred by import needs and remittances by overseas firms.
"There was pressure on the market. Some banks had to buy dollars from the central bank. The trade volume was about $20 million," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The interbank call money rates ended unchanged at 4.0-4.75 percent, dealers said.
